title: [Bug]: Content is always None when MCP server returns an 'error' to the client

linked_prs.title: Fix: Return the content if hasattr(result, 'content') && hasattr(content, 'text') to reiterate from the model
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/dapr_agents/tool/mcp/client.py b/dapr_agents/tool/mcp/client.py
index 3cdbcd3..4f070ec 100644
--- a/dapr_agents/tool/mcp/client.py
+++ b/dapr_agents/tool/mcp/client.py
@@ -355,28 +355,22 @@ class MCPClient(BaseModel):
         Raises:
             ToolError: If the result indicates an error
         """
-        # Handle error result
-        if hasattr(result, 'isError') and result.isError:
-            error_message = "Unknown error"
-            if hasattr(result, 'content') and result.content:
-                for content in result.content:
-                    if hasattr(content, 'text'):
-                        error_message = content.text
-                        break
-            raise ToolError(f"MCP tool error: {error_message}")
-        
         # Extract text content from result
         if hasattr(result, 'content') and result.content:
             text_contents = []
             for content in result.content:
                 if hasattr(content, 'text'):
                     text_contents.append(content.text)
-            
+
             # Return single string if only one content item
             if len(text_contents) == 1:
                 return text_contents[0]
             elif text_contents:
                 return text_contents
+            
+        if hasattr(result, 'isError') and result.isError:
+            # This will only trigger if the above if didn't contain content.text
+            raise ToolError(f"MCP tool error: {result}")
                 
         # Fallback for unexpected formats
         return str(result)
diff --git a/requirements.txt b/requirements.txt
index c31b156..4bf753f 100644
--- a/requirements.txt
+++ b/requirements.txt
@@ -13,4 +13,5 @@ cloudevents==1.11.0
 pyyaml==6.0.2
 rich==13.9.4
 huggingface_hub==0.27.1
-numpy==2.2.2
\ No newline at end of file
+numpy==2.2.2
+mcp==1.6.0
\ No newline at end of file

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it involves tool invocation and tool implementation errors: the agent's tool result handling logic prevents proper output from being returned to the model, affecting agent workflow and iteration. The patch changes tool wrapper logic to enable error content feedback to the LLM.
